newsitem.title: LEBANON: $50 mln Lebanon Holdings placing oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: $50 mln Lebanon Holdings placing oversubscribed.

text.p: A $50 million placing in investment company Lebanon Holdings was oversubscribed by international and Lebanese investors, a placing agent said on Wednesday.

"The placing was well oversubscribed and subscribers have been scaled back," Samer Halawi, deputy manager of business development at Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest, co-placing agent with Britain's SBC Warburg, said.
"There was stong demand from local as well as international investors including Lebanese, European and American insutitutions," Halawi told Reuters.
Trading in Lebanon Holdings shares on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange will start on August 26.
He said that dual listing on the Beirut Stock Exchange was expected soon. "We submitted an application. We are expecting to get approval soon".
Lebanon Holdings, initiated by a mandate from the government, will invest in privately held Lebanese companies prior to their listing on stock exchanges.

Blakeny Management limited, manager of Lebanon Holdings, and Lebanon Invest Asset Management -- a subsidiary of Lebanon Invest -- have identified several investment opportunities in Lebanon, Halawi said.
